result.rationale: The diff shows TopicEmbed.import now uses `category: eh.try(:category_id)` instead of `SiteSetting.embed_category`, so when `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` returns false, category is nil and the post falls back to uncategorized rather than the previously configured embed category. The embed_category setting is also removed, so feed-polled items whose URL host isn't a registered EmbeddableHost silently change destination category. The mechanism is verifiable from the diff lines, though intentality (this may be a deliberate redesign) lowers certainty.

If `record_for_host` returns `nil` (no `EmbeddableHost` row for the URL’s host), this will pass `nil` for category, which is a behavioral change from “always use configured embed_category”.
